cmsIntegration.instructions: When a CMS or editorial workflow is set up, subscribe to changes in this file and alert content managers when `entries` are added. Each entry is a newly uploaded PDF that matched an existing publication but was moved to public/documents/duplicates/ because a canonical file already exists. Show the existing file path (`existingPath`) and duplicate path (`duplicatePath`), and offer manual override actions from `cmsActions`: keep the existing file, or replace it with the new upload.
